issues.title: PVOS-401 — Golden Dataset Expansion
issues.objective: Expand the PVOS Golden Dataset with representative scenarios that exercise existing Product behavior only.
scope: Define and admit bounded Golden Input scenarios
Generate or validate Golden Output through the existing C# Mainline
Establish Scenario Coverage mapped to existing Capability IDs
Register Regression Cases, comparison rules, provenance, and integrity hashes
out_of_scope: New Product behavior, Product Scope, Product Blueprint, Capability status, EOS, or Governance changes
PVOS 2.x, UI, Cloud, full AutoCAD integration, Electrical, or Construction work
Python Product calculation, alternative PVOS Engine, or Legacy Asset promotion
acceptance_criteria: Every admitted scenario maps to existing Product behavior and one bounded claim
Every Golden Input and Output has provenance, expected terminal state, comparison rules, and SHA-256 integrity
The C# Mainline remains the Product result authority
required_evidence: Existing asset inspection and scenario coverage matrix
Golden asset registry with immutable commit and hashes
Per-scenario validation results and excluded-scope verification

issues.title: PVOS-402 — Regression Coverage Expansion
issues.objective: Establish Production Readiness regression coverage for the PM-admitted Golden scenario set.
scope: Review existing C# and external validation coverage against the admitted scenarios
Execute bounded Regression Validation for input, Runtime, result, warnings, errors, and presentation evidence
Compare expected and actual evidence with explicit normalization and failure isolation
Record coverage gaps without adding Product behavior
out_of_scope: Feature implementation or Product Scope expansion
PVOS 2.x, UI, Cloud, full AutoCAD integration, Electrical, Construction, EOS, or Governance changes
Legacy promotion or Python replacement of the C# Mainline
acceptance_criteria: Each admitted Golden scenario has repeatable expected/actual/result evidence
Accepted placement, valid no-fit, and bounded rejected-input families are distinguishable
Failures and blockers are isolated to affected scenarios and dependent claims
required_evidence: Evidence comparison, coverage gaps, and scope-integrity audit

issues.title: PVOS-403 — Python Validation Prototype v0.1
issues.objective: Qualify the existing Python Validation Short Track v0.1 as a controlled Validation / Support Track prototype.
scope: Inspect and identify the existing v0.1 prototype, version, entry command, dependencies, and report contract
Validate bounded scenario iteration, stable result ordering, and PASS, FAIL, and BLOCKED behavior
Execute unit, integration, negative, and regression evidence appropriate to the existing prototype
Prove the prototype invokes the existing C# CLI externally and does not calculate Product results
out_of_scope: Replacing the C# Mainline or creating a second PVOS Engine
Importing C# Product internals or implementing placement, count, capacity, warnings, errors, or geometry in Python
PVOS 2.x, UI, Cloud, full AutoCAD integration, Electrical, Construction, Product Scope, EOS, or Governance changes
acceptance_criteria: The existing prototype has explicit identity, prerequisites, input, execution, output, and failure semantics
Prototype validation evidence covers admitted Golden scenarios without changing Product behavior
Changed-file and source inspection prove Python remains Validation / Support Track only
required_evidence: Unit, integration, negative, and regression results
Report examples and C# Mainline non-replacement proof

issues.title: PVOS-404 — Canonical Project Model Review
issues.objective: Review the Canonical Project Model promotion candidate against explicit eligibility conditions without promoting it.
scope: Review authoritative source, Product need, contract, ownership, compatibility, migration, acceptance, scope authority, and Legacy provenance evidence
Compare the candidate with the current Runtime Input and Product Contract boundaries
Record exactly one allowed eligibility disposition and all evidence gaps
Verify no Legacy file, schema, model, or behavior enters the Product baseline
out_of_scope: Direct or implied Canonical Project Model promotion
Product Contract, Product Scope, Product Blueprint, C# domain model, EOS, or Governance changes
PVOS 2.x, UI, Cloud, full AutoCAD integration, Electrical, or Construction work
acceptance_criteria: Every promotion eligibility condition has factual evidence or an explicit gap
Disposition is NOT_ELIGIBLE, MORE_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED, or ELIGIBLE_FOR_SEPARATE_BASELINE_PROPOSAL
Even an eligible disposition does not promote or modify the Product Contract
required_evidence: Disposition, gaps, zero-promotion proof, and changed-file scope

issues.title: PVOS-405 — Production Readiness Acceptance
issues.objective: Prepare the PVOS 1.1 Production Ready Acceptance Gate and complete evidence package for accountable PM disposition.
scope: Review C# Mainline code integrity without adding Product behavior
Assemble validation, regression, Golden scenario, Python prototype, and Canonical review evidence
Verify repeatability, failure isolation, risks, exclusions, and complete changed-file scope
Assess every approved Production Readiness acceptance criterion and prepare the PM record
out_of_scope: Executor self-acceptance or automatic Production Ready declaration
Product Scope, Capability status, release allocation, EOS, Governance, or Certified Platform changes
PVOS 2.x, Legacy promotion, UI, Cloud, full AutoCAD integration, Electrical, or Construction development
acceptance_criteria: Code, validation, evidence, repeatability, exclusions, and risks are traceable to immutable review evidence
Every required criterion is PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED, or NOT RUN with affected-claim isolation
PM receives a complete record for PRODUCTION_READY, NOT_PRODUCTION_READY, or MORE_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED disposition
required_evidence: Complete evidence chain, risk register, Issues, commits, PR, and PM disposition template
